search_strategy: Focus on 2022–2025 literature, since LLM agents with explicit memory designs emerged recently, prioritizing arXiv preprints and top venues (NeurIPS, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP) alongside OpenAlex records. Prefer empirical studies with ablations or benchmark comparisons (e.g., ALFWorld, WebArena, long-horizon agent benchmarks) and surveys for taxonomy; exclude papers on pure long-context modeling or non-LLM reinforcement-learning memory unless they directly address agents. The thinnest literature is expected for rq6 (failure modes and costs) and for controlled comparisons isolating memory design effects in rq1/rq3.
